format.configuration: existing tsconfig and formatter settings take priority

documentation: Use JSDoc for public APIs and ordinary line comments for implementation details.
Document semantics, optional values, effects and rejected errors; do not duplicate TypeScript types in JSDoc.
Keep comments on the declaration callers use, including interface contracts.
rules: Prefer const and precise types; use unknown with narrowing for unknown input.
Explain necessary any usage and avoid unsupported type or non-null assertions.
Specify public contracts and allow obvious local inference.
Validate external input at runtime; static types alone do not validate JSON.
Respect project module conventions; do not use namespace to imitate modules.
